allocation_complete.reason: The element has no `allocates`, so this axis is met by definition.

completeness.reason: Percent of tank capacity and 1 % resolution covered; display is left to the VCU.

consistency.reason: Consistent with ARCH_VCU_ENERGY_DISPLAY, which reads the ENG fuel level.

design_clarity.reason: Concrete: analogue sensor, 100 ms sampling, 10 s averaging against slosh.

interface_only.reason: The element has no `allocates`, so this axis is met by definition.

no_value_copy.reason: Names no BMS limit, threshold or timing.

parent_fit.reason: Provides the fuel level in percent with 1 % resolution that REQ_ENERGY_SOURCE displays.

variant_consistency.reason: Lives in subsystems/eng (diesel-only folder); its parent is gated the same (`not bev`) or ungated, so it never exists without its parent.
